**Analysis of Net Profit Growth (2024→2025) and Price-to-Earnings (P/E) Ratios**  
*All figures cited per evidence ID; units applied as printed. Figures flagged as AMBIGUOUS are not used in computations.*

### 1. Telecom Egypt (ETEL)
- **Net profit for the year, 31/12/2025**: [ETEL-ETEL_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_en-p6-35] as printed: `"22 578 063 10 111 328 | unit: L.E.(000)"`  
  *Ambiguous*: Identical printed text for 2024 period [ETEL-ETEL_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_en-p6-36]. Column assignment for 2025 vs. 2024 cannot be determined. **Do not compute growth with this figure.**
- **Basic/diluted EPS, 31/12/2025**: [ETEL-ETEL_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_en-p6-55] as printed: `"11.93 4.79 | unit: L.E.(000)"`  
  *Ambiguous*: Unit `L.E.(000)` implies EPS of 11,930 EGP/share, which is implausible given the share price of 141.95 EGP. **P/E ratio not computable; do not compute with this figure.**

### 2. Commercial International Bank (COMI; ticker COMI)
- **Net profit for the year, period Dec. 31, 2025**: [COMI-COMI_FY2025_consolidated_condensed_en-p5-33] as printed: `"| 82,258,815 | 55,256,732 | unit: (All amounts are shown in EGP thousands)"`  
  → 2025 net profit = 82,258,815 (EGP thousands) = **82,258,815,000 EGP** (whole pounds).  
- **Net profit for the year, period Dec. 31, 2024**: [COMI-COMI_FY2025_consolidated_condensed_en-p5-34] as printed: same structure.  
  → 2024 net profit = 55,256,732 (EGP thousands) = **55,256,732,000 EGP**.  
- **Growth 2024→2025**: (82,258,815 − 55,256,732) / 55,256,732 = **48.87%** (ratio valid as both periods use same unit).  
- **Basic EPS, period Dec. 31, 2025**: [COMI-COMI_FY2025_consolidated_condensed_en-p5-39] as printed: `"| 18.25 | 14.72 | unit: (All amounts are shown in EGP thousands)"`  
  *Ambiguous*: Unit `EGP thousands` implies EPS of 18,250 EGP/share; with price 128.00 EGP, P/E would be ~0.007 (nonsensical). **P/E ratio not computable; do not compute with this figure.**

### 3. Edita Food Industries (EFID; ticker EFID)
- **Net profit for the year (consolidated), period 31 December 2025**: [EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-30] as printed: `"2 695 301 670 | 1 606 727 698 | unit: EGP"`  
  → 2025 net profit = **2,695,301,670 EGP** (whole pounds).  
- **Net profit for the year (consolidated), period 31 December 2024**: [EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-31] as printed: same structure.  
  → 2024 net profit = **1,606,727,698 EGP**.  
- **Growth 2024→2025**: (2,695,301,670 − 1,606,727,698) / 1,606,727,698 = **67.75%**.  
- **Basic and diluted EPS (consolidated), period 31 December 2025**: [EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-38] as printed: `"Basic and Diluted earnings per share | 30 | 2.18 | 1.09 | unit: EGP"`  
  → 2025 EPS = **2.18 EGP** (whole pounds).  
- **P/E ratio**: Price per share = 20.40 EGP [investor-stated cutoff price]. P/E = 20.40 / 2.18 = **9.36** (computable; unit EGP confirmed).

### 4. Talaat Moustafa Group (TMGH; ticker TMGH)
- **Net profit for the year (consolidated), period 2025**: [TMGH-TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en-p7-55] as printed: `"18,201,981,482 | 12,769,517,325 | unit: LE"`  
  → 2025 net profit = **18,201,981,482 LE** (whole pounds).  
- **Net profit for the year (consolidated), period 2024 (Restated)**: The second figure in the same row is **12,769,517,325 LE** (whole pounds).  
- **Growth 2024→2025**: (18,201,981,482 − 12,769,517,325) / 12,769,517,325 = **42.54%**.  
- **Earnings per Share (consolidated), period 2025**: [TMGH-TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en-p7-61] as printed: `"Earnings per Share | (39) | 6.98 | 4.38 | unit: LE"`  
  → 2025 EPS = **6.98 LE** (whole pounds).  
- **P/E ratio**: Price per share = 82.50 EGP [investor-stated cutoff price]. P/E = 82.50 / 6.98 = **11.82** (computable; unit LE confirmed).
